_about: Hand-confirmed SNES map -> PR map pairs (US v1.0 map ids; PR (x, y) = SNES (x + dx, y + dy)). tools/snes_maps.py lists them first and its build follows exits from them, so one confirmed room can place its neighbours. Add a pair when you have confirmed it in the game or by its objects; rebuild with: python tools/snes_maps.py build

0.note: World of Balance: the PR world map keeps the SNES tile grid (Narshe's entrance object at (84, 34) as the SNES exit)

1.note: World of Ruin: as the World of Balance

126.note: Doma Castle (WoR) east wing: BNW's merchant room, the Remedy chest SNES (55, 5) = PR (55, 8) (profile_bnw.py)

391.note: Kefka's Tower's outer stair (16x32, reached from 384): the PR room's 9-wide platform and its one-tile stair lie exactly on the SNES map's walkable platform and stair at this offset (walk 0.96 over 48 cells, tiles share 1.0 / 0.75); confirmed 2026-11-20 by overlaying the two (ted-maps). T-Edition's map 435 copies this layout.
